points.K6: 维护前停机断电、挂牌、冷却
points.K7: 开盖调试：联锁和安全回路不短接
points.K8: 定期维护：按厂家周期和运行小时

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台外壳关好的激光焊接机旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed handheld laser welding machine cabinet in a workshop, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光设备的高压与维护安全。
overlay: 激光设备高压与维护安全

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 焊机显示屏不亮，阿杰拿起螺丝刀想拆外壳
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a laser welding machine with a dark display screen and picks up a screwdriver toward the cabinet screws.
shots.narration: 焊机屏幕不亮，阿杰想拆开看看。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李快步过来伸手拦住
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hurries over and raises his hand to stop the young male student, the cabinet still closed.
shots.narration: 老李拦住他：机柜里有高压。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李拔下插头，在设备上挂空白报修牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls out the power plug and hangs a blank repair tag on the closed machine.
shots.narration: 停机断电挂牌，交给授权人员修。

shots.section_title: 机内有高压电和强激光
shots.scene: 设备外壳透视图：电源模块闪电符号、激光器光束符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway outline of a closed laser machine, a power module marked with a lightning bolt and a laser source marked with a beam icon. No text.
shots.narration: 激光设备里，有高压电也有强激光。
overlay: 机内有高压电和强激光

shots.section_title: 机内有高压电和强激光
shots.scene: 触电和烧伤两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a hand receiving an electric shock and a burned hand, beside a closed laser machine. No text.
shots.narration: 处理不当，会触电、烧伤，甚至致命。

shots.section_title: 机内有高压电和强激光
shots.scene: 激光电源的电极接头旁画着很大的闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the electrode connectors of a laser power unit drawn inside a closed housing with a very large lightning bolt beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 有的激光电源，电压可达上万伏。

shots.section_title: 机内有高压电和强激光
shots.scene: 光束之外四个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser beam in the centre surrounded by four icons, a flame, a bursting capacitor, a lightning bolt and a chemical bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 光束之外，还有火灾、爆炸、触电和化学危害。

shots.section_title: 机内有高压电和强激光
shots.scene: 储能电容组和闪光灯冒出裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bank of storage capacitors and a flash lamp with crack lines, a warning burst around them. No text.
shots.narration: 储能电容和闪光灯，故障时可能爆裂。

shots.section_title: 当心触电标志与开盖联锁
shots.scene: 【实拍】激光设备外壳上的当心触电警告标志特写（设备断电，遮挡品牌型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a high voltage warning sign on the closed metal housing of a laser machine.
shots.narration: 外壳上的当心触电标志，就是警告。
overlay: 当心触电标志与开盖联锁

shots.section_title: 当心触电标志与开盖联锁
shots.scene: 联锁示意：顶盖一开，开关断开，高压切断
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the top cover of a laser unit lifting, an interlock switch opening and the high voltage circuit line breaking. No text.
shots.narration: 开盖联锁：盖一打开，高压就切断。

shots.section_title: 当心触电标志与开盖联锁
shots.scene: 高压断开后，风扇仍画着带电符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: after the high voltage line is broken, a cooling fan inside the unit still marked with a small lightning bolt. No text.
shots.narration: 可风扇等部件，仍然带电。

shots.section_title: 当心触电标志与开盖联锁
shots.scene: 透明护罩挡住开口，门上有联锁开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clear plastic guard covering an opening and an interlock switch on the door, two shields drawn. No text.
shots.narration: 透明护罩加门联锁，两道保护。

shots.section_title: 当心触电标志与开盖联锁
shots.scene: 手越过开口线，电火花跳向手，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand crossing the line of an opening while a spark jumps through humid air toward it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 手不越开口，潮湿时高压能隔空放电。

shots.section_title: 只有授权专业人员才能开柜维修
shots.scene: 说明书上画着维修工具和人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open equipment manual with a wrench icon and a qualified technician icon. No text.
shots.narration: 说明书写明：维修只限专业人员。
overlay: 只有授权专业人员才能开柜维修

shots.section_title: 只有授权专业人员才能开柜维修
shots.scene: 学生拿螺丝刀拆机柜，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student using a screwdriver on a laser machine cabinet, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 学生和非专业人员，严禁擅自拆机。

shots.section_title: 只有授权专业人员才能开柜维修
shots.scene: 报修流程：学生、实验室负责人、厂家或授权维修人员
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a repair flow with three steps, a student reporting, a lab supervisor and a qualified service technician. No text.
shots.narration: 内部故障先报修，由厂家或授权人员修。

shots.section_title: 只有授权专业人员才能开柜维修
shots.scene: 老李对照维修方案逐项确认
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a blank step by step repair plan beside a switched off laser machine.
shots.narration: 动手维修的人，必须清楚每一步。

shots.section_title: 只有授权专业人员才能开柜维修
shots.scene: 屏幕上的开盖演示，旁边模仿的人打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a training video of an opened cabinet on a screen, a person copying it crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 看开盖演示，只学原理，不模仿。

shots.section_title: 断电后仍有残余高压：等待放电、验电
shots.scene: 拔下插头，电源里的电容仍发着光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plug pulled out of the socket while the capacitors inside the power unit still glow with stored charge. No text.
shots.narration: 拔了电，电容里还存着高压。
overlay: 断电后仍有残余高压：等待放电、验电

shots.section_title: 断电后仍有残余高压：等待放电、验电
shots.scene: 时钟和说明书图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock icon next to an open manual, the charge in a capacitor slowly fading. No text.
shots.narration: 按说明书规定的时间，等待放电。

shots.section_title: 断电后仍有残余高压：等待放电、验电
shots.scene: 老李用测试仪表测量端子，表盘空白
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer in insulated gloves touching meter probes to power terminals, the meter display blank. No text.
shots.narration: 再由授权人员验电，确认无电。

shots.section_title: 断电后仍有残余高压：等待放电、验电
shots.scene: 手指去碰端子试电，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bare finger reaching to touch a terminal to feel for electricity, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不凭感觉，绝不用手去试。

shots.section_title: 断电后仍有残余高压：等待放电、验电
shots.scene: 拆下的旧电源端子朝内放在箱子里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a removed old power supply placed in a box with its terminals facing inward and a lightning icon on it. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下的旧电源，也当带电件对待。

shots.section_title: 维修全程戴绝缘手套
shots.scene: 老李戴上绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on a pair of thick rubber insulating gloves before repair work on a switched off machine.
shots.narration: 维修全过程，戴好绝缘手套。

shots.section_title: 维修全程戴绝缘手套
shots.scene: 【实拍】检查绝缘手套：看等级标识和试验日期，从袖口卷起查漏气
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands checking a rubber insulating glove, reading its rating mark and test date, then rolling the cuff to trap air and look for leaks.
shots.narration: 用前查等级和试验日期，卷起查漏。

shots.section_title: 维修全程戴绝缘手套
shots.scene: 摘下手套徒手拆线，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gloves taken off and bare hands pulling a wire inside a machine, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不能图方便，摘了手套徒手拆线。

shots.section_title: 维修全程戴绝缘手套
shots.scene: 普通线手套和绝缘手套对比，线手套打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cotton work glove crossed out beside a thick rubber insulating glove with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 普通线手套，不是绝缘手套。

shots.section_title: 维修全程戴绝缘手套
shots.scene: 戴手套和护目镜拿烧黑的零件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands in gloves holding a burned blackened part, the person wearing safety goggles. No text.
shots.narration: 拿烧坏的零件，戴手套和护目镜。

shots.section_title: 维护前停机断电、挂牌、冷却
shots.scene: 关机、拔钥匙、断开总电源三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three steps, a power button switched off, a key pulled out and a main breaker switched down. No text.
shots.narration: 维护前，关机、拔钥匙、断电源。
overlay: 维护前停机断电、挂牌、冷却

shots.section_title: 维护前停机断电、挂牌、冷却
shots.scene: 【实拍】在已断开的电源开关上加锁并挂空白维修牌（设备断电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand fitting a safety padlock and a blank maintenance tag onto a switched off isolating switch.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌，防止别人误开机。

shots.section_title: 维护前停机断电、挂牌、冷却
shots.scene: 镜片和喷嘴冒热气，旁边是等待的时钟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lens holder and a nozzle with heat waves rising, a clock beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 高温部件先冷却，再动手。

shots.section_title: 维护前停机断电、挂牌、冷却
shots.scene: 维修区用围挡围起，旁人站在线外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a repair area around a laser machine fenced off with a barrier, other people standing outside the line. No text.
shots.narration: 维修区围起来，无关人员不靠近。

shots.section_title: 维护前停机断电、挂牌、冷却
shots.scene: 开着机打开镜片仓，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lens compartment on a welding head being opened while the power lamp is on, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 镜片仓在光路上，开着机绝不拆。

shots.section_title: 维护前停机断电、挂牌、冷却
shots.scene: 冷却水管漏水流向电线，先断电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cooling water hose leaking toward electric wires, a hand switching off the main breaker first. No text.
shots.narration: 冷却水漏到电线旁，先断电再处理。

shots.section_title: 开盖调试：联锁和安全回路不短接
shots.scene: 开盖通电调试，只有老李一人在受控区内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a technician working on a powered unit inside a fenced controlled area, everyone else outside. No text.
shots.narration: 开盖通电调试，只由专业人员按规程做。
overlay: 开盖调试：联锁和安全回路不短接

shots.section_title: 开盖调试：联锁和安全回路不短接
shots.scene: 导线短接联锁开关，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a jumper wire bridging an interlock switch, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 安全回路和联锁，绝不能短接。

shots.section_title: 开盖调试：联锁和安全回路不短接
shots.scene: 原厂备件打勾，不同型号零件打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an original spare part with a tick beside a different looking part crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 换件用原厂备件，不乱换型号。

shots.section_title: 开盖调试：联锁和安全回路不短接
shots.scene: 出光调试：关好盖，门口挂牌，人员戴防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: alignment work with the cover closed, a laser warning sign at the door and people wearing laser safety goggles. No text.
shots.narration: 要出光调试，清场挂牌、戴对眼镜。

shots.section_title: 开盖调试：联锁和安全回路不短接
shots.scene: 电脑给设备刷固件，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laptop connected to a machine with a firmware upload bar, crossed out, an alarm bell icon fading. No text.
shots.narration: 固件参数不乱改，否则联锁报警会失灵。

shots.section_title: 定期维护：按厂家周期和运行小时
shots.scene: 说明书上的维护周期表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open manual showing a maintenance schedule chart with blank cells. No text.
shots.narration: 维护多久一次，先看厂家要求。
overlay: 定期维护：按厂家周期和运行小时

shots.section_title: 定期维护：按厂家周期和运行小时
shots.scene: 运行小时计：一班和两班的进度条
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an hour meter with two progress bars, one shift and two shifts, the second filling twice as fast. No text.
shots.narration: 周期按运行小时算，开得多修得勤。

shots.section_title: 定期维护：按厂家周期和运行小时
shots.scene: 排满的日程表，维护卡被一再往后推
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crowded schedule where a maintenance card keeps getting pushed later, small hazard icons piling up. No text.
shots.narration: 太忙不想停，隐患越攒越多。

shots.section_title: 定期维护：按厂家周期和运行小时
shots.scene: 设备突然停机，等人、维修、调机三个时钟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a broken down machine with three clocks, waiting for a technician, repairing and readjusting. No text.
shots.narration: 突然坏了，等修调机，停得更久。

shots.section_title: 定期维护：按厂家周期和运行小时
shots.scene: 维护计划写进设备台账
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a maintenance plan sheet being filed into an equipment ledger book. No text.
shots.narration: 维护写进计划，记进设备台账。

shots.section_title: 光路易损件：镜片、喷嘴和风琴管
shots.scene: 切割头拆下的镜片、喷嘴和水管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: parts taken from a cutting head laid out on a cloth, a lens, a nozzle and a cooling hose, with heat and smoke icons. No text.
shots.narration: 镜片、喷嘴、水管，天天受热受烟。
overlay: 光路易损件：镜片、喷嘴和风琴管

shots.section_title: 光路易损件：镜片、喷嘴和风琴管
shots.scene: 切割头上方伸缩的风琴管，里面是光路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a folding bellows cover above a cutting head stretching and shrinking, a beam path inside it and dust kept out. No text.
shots.narration: 风琴管护着光路，挡住粉尘。

shots.section_title: 光路易损件：镜片、喷嘴和风琴管
shots.scene: 风琴管上有破洞，挂停用牌；刷子清积灰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bellows cover with a torn hole and a blank out of service tag, and a brush cleaning dust off it. No text.
shots.narration: 风琴管破了就停用，积灰定期清。

shots.section_title: 光路易损件：镜片、喷嘴和风琴管
shots.scene: 碎镜片装进密封袋，徒手捡打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: broken lens pieces placed into a sealed bag with tweezers, a bare hand picking them up crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 碎镜片别徒手碰，装袋交专人。

shots.section_title: 光路易损件：镜片、喷嘴和风琴管
shots.scene: 小瓶酒精远离火源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small bottle of alcohol and a lens tissue kept far from a flame icon. No text.
shots.narration: 擦镜片的酒精，少量取用远离火源。

shots.section_title: 小零件松脱，引出一串故障
shots.scene: 一排倒下的多米诺骨牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of dominoes falling one after another, each domino showing a small machine part icon. No text.
shots.narration: 设备故障，常像推倒的多米诺。
overlay: 小零件松脱，引出一串故障

shots.section_title: 小零件松脱，引出一串故障
shots.scene: 护罩螺栓松了，护罩掉到输出镜前
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: loose bolts on a small guard inside a laser, the guard dropping in front of an orange output mirror. No text.
shots.narration: 护罩螺栓松了，掉到输出镜前。

shots.section_title: 小零件松脱，引出一串故障
shots.scene: 碎屑溅回，镜片出现裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: debris spattering back onto the mirror surface and a crack line spreading across it. No text.
shots.narration: 碎屑溅回，镜片开裂。

shots.section_title: 小零件松脱，引出一串故障
shots.scene: 镜片碎裂向内塌，风机和电源冒烟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked mirror collapsing inward into a low pressure chamber, a fan and a power unit smoking. No text.
shots.narration: 镜片还是密封边界，一碎可能毁掉激光器。

shots.section_title: 小零件松脱，引出一串故障
shots.scene: 跑偏的光熔穿水管，水喷到电气接头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a misaligned beam melting a hole in a cooling water hose and water spraying onto an electrical connector. No text.
shots.narration: 跑偏的光熔穿水管，水喷到电器上。

shots.section_title: 小零件松脱，引出一串故障
shots.scene: 光打在喷嘴内壁，喷嘴孔被焊死
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam hitting the inside wall of a nozzle and the nozzle hole sealed shut by molten metal. No text.
shots.narration: 光打偏了，喷嘴孔也被焊死。

shots.section_title: 小零件松脱，引出一串故障
shots.scene: 按下停机键，只坏了几个小零件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand pressing the stop button early, only three small damaged parts on the table. No text.
shots.narration: 及时停机，只坏了几个小零件。

shots.section_title: 小零件松脱，引出一串故障
shots.scene: 日历翻过几个月，维护时打开一眼看到松脱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: calendar pages flipping over several months, then a technician opening the housing during routine maintenance and spotting the loose guard. No text.
shots.narration: 松了几个月没人发现，按时维护就能看到。

shots.section_title: 修前记录故障，修后检查验收
shots.scene: 记录本上画着故障、报警和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank fault log with icons for a fault, an alarm bell and a clock. No text.
shots.narration: 先记下故障现象、报警和时间。
overlay: 修前记录故障，修后检查验收

shots.section_title: 修前记录故障，修后检查验收
shots.scene: 按说明书逐项排查，乱换电路板打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist followed step by step, and a hand randomly swapping circuit boards crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 按说明书排查，不凭猜测乱换件。

shots.section_title: 修前记录故障，修后检查验收
shots.scene: 老李用合适的工具把护罩装回拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses a proper tool to refit and tighten a guard inside a switched off machine.
shots.narration: 拆下的护罩，用合适工具装回拧紧。

shots.section_title: 修前记录故障，修后检查验收
shots.scene: 对照清单逐项检查，授权人员试机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a technician ticking a checklist for each fastener, then a trial run with the cover closed. No text.
shots.narration: 修完对照清单检查，授权人员试机。

shots.section_title: 修前记录故障，修后检查验收
shots.scene: 维修记录写好，验收合格后摘下维修牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a repair record being filled in, then a blank maintenance tag removed after acceptance. No text.
shots.narration: 写好维修记录，验收合格再摘牌。

shots.section_title: 修前记录故障，修后检查验收
shots.scene: 活没干完：写清进度，螺钉零件装盒标好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unfinished repair left with a handover note, screws and parts in a labelled box, the machine still locked out. No text.
shots.narration: 没修完就交接，写清进度，零件装盒。

shots.section_title: 钥匙和管理员密码专人管，改动要登记
shots.scene: 王老师把钥匙和密封的密码信封锁进柜子
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator locks a machine key and a sealed envelope into a small key cabinet.
shots.narration: 钥匙和管理员密码，由负责人保管。
overlay: 钥匙和管理员密码专人管，改动要登记

shots.section_title: 钥匙和管理员密码专人管，改动要登记
shots.scene: 空白密码框旁画着更换箭头，贴在机器上的便签打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an empty password box with a change arrow, and a sticky note stuck on the machine crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 出厂默认密码要改，新密码不外传。

shots.section_title: 钥匙和管理员密码专人管，改动要登记
shots.scene: 参数登记表：原值、新值、日期、操作人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a parameter change log with four blank columns before a settings screen. No text.
shots.narration: 改参数前记原值，改后登记新值。

shots.section_title: 钥匙和管理员密码专人管，改动要登记
shots.scene: 屏幕上的红色提示框，手指停住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a red alert box on a settings screen and a finger pausing above it. No text.
shots.narration: 屏幕上的红色提示，看清再动手。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 高压闪电、电容、绝缘手套三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a lightning bolt, a capacitor and a rubber insulating glove. No text.
shots.narration: 机内高压，断电后还有残余电荷。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 授权人员、上锁挂牌、联锁三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a qualified technician, a padlock with a tag and an interlock switch. No text.
shots.narration: 授权人员维修，上锁挂牌，不短接联锁。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 维护周期表和维修记录本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a maintenance schedule and a repair record book side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 按时维护，修前修后都要记录。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在灭火器和急停按钮旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a wall mounted fire extinguisher and a red emergency stop button, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：激光设备火灾与急停。
